falseFriends.station: Use 'pracovní stanice' for workstation, not 'stanice' (train/bus station)
falseFriends.shift: Use 'směna' for work shift, not 'posun' (movement) or keyboard 'shift'

grammarNotes.caseSystem: 7 cases with diacritics. Nominative: 'dostupnost'; genitive: 'výpočet dostupnosti'; locative: 'v přestavbě'.
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Three genders: 'celková efektivnost' (f), 'skutečný čas cyklu' (m), 'plánované množství' (n)
grammarNotes.germanInfluence: German-origin terms exist (seřízení, šichta) — use Czech standard terms in professional software.
grammarNotes.genitiveConstructions: Genitive for compound terms: 'důvod zastavení' (stop reason)
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Comma decimal, thin space thousands: '85,5%', '1 000 kusů'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Singular genitive modifier is PREFERRED for manufacturing UI labels: 'příčiny ztráty rychlosti' (reasons + loss [gen.sg] + speed [gen.sg]). Plural genitive 'příčiny ztrát rychlosti' ('ztrát' [gen.pl]) may be governed by Czech grammar but should be treated as a soft warning, not a hard error. For automated audit purposes, treat singular genitive as correct. Flag plural genitive forms for G3 native speaker review.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE is dominant. Czech term: 'Celková efektivnost zařízení' (CEZ) — known but OEE preferred in software.
industryContext.cezAcronym: CEZ documented in Czech Wikipedia. OEE more common in practice.
industryContext.manufacturingGDP: One of Europe's highest manufacturing-to-GDP ratios (~28%)
standardsUsed: ČSN ISO 22400 (adoption expected per CEN membership)

commonMistakes: Incorrect case endings in technical terminology
Using German-origin colloquialisms ('šichta') instead of standard Czech ('směna')

Compound plural modifier ambiguity: 'příčiny ztrát rychlosti' vs 'příčiny ztráty rychlosti' — genitive plural 'ztrát' vs singular 'ztráty'. Prefer singular modifier (names the concept); flag for G3 native speaker review
notes: OEE is used; CEZ exists as Czech alternative but OEE preferred. Formal 'vy' (vykání). 7-case system. Strong German automotive influence. P95 expansion 2.10x.
